'''Sukarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] fallen [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and one of the leaders of the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] cult.

==Biography==
Sukarr was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alongside [[Nikkos Tyris]] traveling with the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] to [[Susevfi]].<ref name="IJ" />

Sukarr also fathered a daughter, [[Mei (Dark Jedi)|Mei]], and trained her in his practice.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />

On Susevfi, Tyris led his followers down the path to the dark side, studying an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] manuscript to learn their dark techniques. The cult, which Tyris dubbed the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]], would grow into a large enough threat to cause the Jedi Council concern. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] progressed, the group was approached by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the Confederacy and the alter ego of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Tyranus. Dooku gifted Tyris with a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] favored by former Anzati Jedi [[Volfe Karkko]] and convinced the cult leader to join the Separatist war effort. Granting the Jensaarai members the title of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] within the ranks of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], Sukarr was stationed with Tyris on Susevfi during the final days of the war.<ref name="IJ" />

A month before the war would end, the Jedi Order dispatched the Knights [[Nejaa Halcyon]], [[Ylenic It'kla]], and ''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Desertwind]]'' to remove the Jensaari leadership. Attacking their fortress on Susevfi, the Jedi engaged Tyris, Sukarr, and [[Dustrose]], in an attempt to remove the Jensaari from the war. Over the course of the fighting, all three Jensaarai fell, with the Jedi known as Desertwind delivering the fatal blow to this individual.<ref name="IJ" />
